candidates.claim: CORP access port sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 is assigned to access VLAN 10 (the OT VLAN) instead of its zone VLAN 30, so a non-OT-facing port is active in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Set GigabitEthernet1/0/11 on sw-it-01 back to access VLAN 30 and confirm that no OT device is connected to that port.

candidates.claim: The switchport access VLAN of sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 changed from the approved baseline value 30 to 10, and this deviation is not reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change with the approved baseline: either revert GigabitEthernet1/0/11 to VLAN 30 or document and approve the change.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 has a MGMT-zone interface (GigabitEthernet0, 10.10.99.12/24) with no inbound ACL and a default route whose next hop 10.10.99.1 is in MGMT, alongside the OUTSIDE default route on GigabitEthernet0/0/0, so MGMT traffic that reaches rtr-01 can leave toward OUTSIDE without passing the fw-01 MGMT_IN or OUTSIDE_IN policy.
candidates.remediation: Remove the MGMT-facing path through rtr-01 or remove the default route via 10.10.99.1, and ensure all MGMT-to-OUTSIDE traffic is filtered by fw-01.
